description: This file contains implementations of statistical tests and tools for the PySpark MLlib, including classes for Chi-Square tests, correlation, Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests, summarization of vectors, and a multivariate Gaussian representation.

classes.name: ChiSquareTest
classes.description: Provides methods to perform Pearson's independence test on datasets with categorical features and labels.

classes.name: Correlation
classes.description: Provides methods to compute correlation matrices for datasets of vectors using specified methods.

classes.name: KolmogorovSmirnovTest
classes.description: Provides methods to perform the Kolmogorov-Smirnov test for continuous distributions.

classes.name: Summarizer
classes.description: Offers tools for vectorized statistical summaries of MLlib Vectors within DataFrames.

classes.name: SummaryBuilder
classes.description: A helper class to build summary statistics for columns, used internally by Summarizer.

classes.name: MultivariateGaussian
classes.description: Represents a multivariate Gaussian distribution with mean vector and covariance matrix.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Performs Pearson's independence test on a dataset for features against labels.

methods.name: corr
methods.description: Computes the correlation matrix for a dataset of vectors using specified method.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Performs the Kolmogorov-Smirnov test for a sample dataset against a specified distribution.

methods.name: mean
methods.description: Computes the mean vector of features, optionally weighted.

methods.name: sum
methods.description: Computes the sum of features, optionally weighted.

methods.name: variance
methods.description: Computes the variance of features, optionally weighted.

methods.name: std
methods.description: Computes the standard deviation of features, optionally weighted.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts the number of vectors, optionally weighted.

methods.name: numNonZeros
methods.description: Counts the number of non-zero elements in features, optionally weighted.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Finds the maximum value in features, optionally weighted.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Finds the minimum value in features, optionally weighted.

methods.name: normL1
methods.description: Calculates the L1 norm of features, optionally weighted.

methods.name: normL2
methods.description: Calculates the L2 norm of features, optionally weighted.
